newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on fresh buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on fresh buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Thursday amid fresh buying by investors attracted by low prices of select blue chips, dealers said.
"It seems the market has bottomed out," dealer Sajjad Mankani of BMA Capital Management said. "But the rise will be restricted as major investors are still not sure about the potential upside.".
The Karachi 100-share index rose 13.75 points, or 0.88 percent, to close at 1,582.62. Losers led gainers 148 to 140. PTCL rose 1.0 rupee to 30.20 rupees and ICI Pkistan 0.75 to 22.55.
